notes.text: English: The page chooses an L-embedding into the algebraic closure and comments on the construction numbered (37). The author describes a fibre heuristically as a product of discs and writes “j’ai eu un peu peur d’y mettre … zéro à g”, followed by a boundary map pi_2(bar D_J) to pi_1(fibre), identified vertically with T^J, and the explicit question/exclamation “(?)!”. These are the author’s doubts, not editorial conclusions. The construction (37) itself is outside this assigned page.

English: A five-object diagram is used to motivate a morphism between homotopy exact sequences. The source identifies pi_2(xi) with zero and concludes that the composite pi_2(D_J) to T^J to pi_{U/K} is zero. It then states conditionally that injectivity of T^J to pi_{U/K} implies the first boundary map is zero. The formal diagram implication is valid once the displayed commutative morphism of sequences and the stated identifications exist: naturality gives g composed with delta equal to delta-prime composed with a, and a has zero target. If g is injective, delta is zero. No geometric existence of the fibrations, comparison theorem, or asserted injectivity is verified by this formal check.

English: The lower-right group label is not normalized to the mathematically expected E_K: the draft retains K|U because the compressed subscript admits both shapes. The six other stacked identification signs contain a curved upright beside a straight upright; they are encoded consistently as wr plus a vertical stroke, while the two pi_2 identifications and the earlier fibre identification use two straight vertical strokes. None is turned into a horizontal equality.

English: The opening article is le; the added beginning-of-homotopy-sequence phrase attaches before fibré. The first failed reformulation after the injection has both elle and the added devrait cancelled; the later devrait avoir is replaced by a. Relative is replaced by de celle relative, and ligne by colonne. These local revision states are retained individually.

English: There are two genuine commutative diagrams and no separate drawing. The light bottom-left 133 is retained as foliation of unestablished hand. Line_count counts 26 principal text/display/object rows; interlinear revisions, individual arrow-only levels, and foliation are inventoried separately. The word before zéro and several arrowheads remain open for independent reading.
